name: Screws
description: Based on the ISO metric screw standards. Select sketch points or circles: each gets a screw, and its hole if you want one. With nothing selected, one screw sits on the origin.

size.title: Size
size.description: Common machine screw sizes with the coarse thread. For any other metric size, such as a fine pitch, fill in Custom size.

custom_size.title: Custom size
custom_size.description: Optional. A metric size that replaces Size, such as M8x1 or M3.5x0.6. If the chosen Head has no standard for this size, fill in both Custom head diameter and Custom head height.

length.title: Length
length.description: Length as the standard lists it: under the head, overall for a countersunk head (ISO 10642, ISO 2009 and ISO 7046-1 count the head), and overall for a set screw or a threaded rod.

head.title: Head
head.description: The head is sized from the standard for the chosen Size and Drive: a slotted or Phillips pan or countersunk head is not the same size as a hex socket one. Set screw and Threaded rod have no head. Where a head has no standard for a size, set both custom head dimensions.

drive.title: Drive
drive.description: Standard cuts the usual drive for the Head: a hex socket in a socket, button or countersunk head and in a set screw, Phillips in a pan head and in a countersunk head below M3, a slot in a cheese head, none in a hex head. Every drive is sized from its standard unless Drive size is filled.

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: Flat is a square end, and on a set screw the ISO 4026 flat point: a 45° chamfer down to a smaller flat. Point is a self-tapping gimlet and counts as part of the length. Cup is a 120° recess in the end, and on a set screw the ISO 4029 cup point, chamfered outside down to the rim.

create.title: Create
create.description: Screw only builds the screw, on the origin when nothing is selected. Screw and hole also drills the part under each selected point, and Hole only drills without a screw.

hole_type.title: Hole type
hole_type.description: Used when Create drills a hole. Clearance is the ISO 273 through hole for the Size. Head recessed adds a counterbore, or a countersink for a countersunk head, and sinks the screw so its head ends flush. Tapped cuts the screw's own thread. Each is as deep as the screw reaches.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the point or circle you selected before opening this. To place by name instead, type the sketch name here and fill in Sketch point.

sketch_point.title: Sketch point
sketch_point.description: Optional. The id of a point or circle in that sketch, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection.

drive_size.title: Drive size
drive_size.description: Optional. Leave empty for the standard size of the chosen Drive. Hex socket: key size, or key size and depth, such as 2.5 or 2.5x1.3. Torx: T10. Phillips: PH2 or PH2x2.1. Slotted: width and depth, such as 0.8x0.7. A Torx recess in a head too low for its standard depth is cut shallower, leaving 0.3 mm under it; the reply gives the depth cut.

head_diameter.title: Custom head diameter
head_diameter.description: Optional. Leave empty for the standard head. On a hex head, the width across the flats. Filled alone, it keeps the standard height. A countersunk head, or a size with no standard head, needs Custom head height too.

head_height.title: Custom head height
head_height.description: Optional. Leave empty for the standard head. Filled alone, it keeps the standard diameter. A countersunk head, or a size with no standard head, needs Custom head diameter too.

thread_length.title: Thread length
thread_length.description: Optional. Threaded length from the tip. A point is not included. Leave empty for the standard: the whole shank on a short screw, and the standard thread length on one long enough to have a plain shank. Type the full length to thread it all.

thread_modeled.title: Modeled thread
thread_modeled.description: Cut the thread profile into the shank. Off leaves a cosmetic thread, which rebuilds faster.
